title: Some feedback
body:
Overall happy with the app, however:
- it would be nice being able to interact with the habits directly on the widget
- the aesthetics of the “☀️Habit tracker🌜” page doesn’t fit the rest of the app (this is a very minor critique but it would still be nice to be able to adapt this) 
- most importantly: if I fail a habit that is of the “quit” type, I can’t seem to track this in any way. If I for example try to reset it, it is still marked as completed for the day

title: Decent but lots of small issues
body:
So far it seems pretty useful. I have to use it for a few more days to get a better view on whether it can actually keep me in the habits. 

There are though many small irritating issues I would like to see fixed real soon. 

Stuff like: 
Any exercise type habits (Health connected) seem to be stuck on hour a day. Doesn’t matter what I change them to. Changing them will set them to 30 min will set them to 30 hours a day. 

Adding / editing habits is impossible in dark mode, since all texts are dark as well.

title: Very good Habit tracker
body: I've been on the hunt for a solid routine app for quite some time, and I finally stumbled upon this gem. It almost deserves a perfect 5-star rating considering how well it covers all the bases. However, there's one major annoyance that's been bothering me – the inability to customize the end time of my day. Currently, all days kick off at 00:00, and I'm personally aiming for a later end time, around 01:00 or 02:00. This particular aspect is incredibly frustrating, and it's something they definitely need to address. That said, apart from this issue, I wholeheartedly endorse this app
